newsitem.title: CROATIA: Nine Croats injured as their van hits landmine.
newsitem.headline: Nine Croats injured as their van hits landmine.

text.p: Nine people were injured, four seriously, when their van hit a landmine in eastern Croatia on Tuesday afternoon, state television reported.
It said the nine, all residents of the former frontline village of Laslovo still under Serb control from the 1991 Serb-Croat war, were going to a funeral there when the accident happened.
Doctors at an emergency hospital in nearby Osijek received the injured but were not available to comment on their condition.
Thousands of mines and other unexploded devices are scattered in former war zones across Croatia and experts say it will take at least 10 years to clear them.
